## Loading packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(posterior)
```

## Load results

```{r}
sweep_id <- "var-sweep-01"
res_dir  <- file.path("results", sweep_id)
fig_dir  <- file.path("figures", sweep_id)
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

truth  <- readRDS(file.path(res_dir, "truth.rds"))
s      <- truth$settings
A_true <- truth$dgp$A                 # list of true lag matrices, original scale
p_true <- length(A_true)
N      <- nrow(A_true[[1]])

files <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "_p\\d{2}_(fit|prior)\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
res   <- map(files, readRDS)

model_labels <- c(
  normal    = sprintf("Normal (sd = %g)", s$normal$A_sd),
  minnesota = "Minnesota (hierarchical)",
  arr2_flat = sprintf("ARR2 flat (R2 mean = %.2g)", s$arr2_flat$mean_R2),
  arr2_minn = sprintf("ARR2 Minn. (R2 mean = %.2g)", s$arr2_minn$mean_R2)
)
label_model <- function(m) factor(model_labels[m], levels = model_labels)

draws_tbl <- function(x) as_tibble(as.data.frame(x))   # drop draws_df class

p_grid <- sort(unique(map_int(res, ~ as.integer(.x$cell$p))))
length(res)
```

## Sampler diagnostics

```{r}
diag_tbl <- map_dfr(res, function(r) {
  tibble(model       = r$cell$model,
         p           = r$cell$p,
         mode        = r$cell$mode,
         divergences = sum(r$diagnostics$num_divergent),
         max_rhat    = max(r$summary$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
         time_s      = round(r$time, 1))
})

diag_tbl %>%
  filter(divergences > 0 | max_rhat > 1.01) %>%
  arrange(mode, model, p) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## Bayesian R2 draws

```{r}
r2_draws <- map_dfr(res, function(r) {
  draws_tbl(r$draws) %>%
    select(.draw, stable, starts_with("R2B_eq"), R2B_mean, R2B_trace) %>%
    mutate(model = r$cell$model, p = r$cell$p, mode = r$cell$mode)
}) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(starts_with("R2B_eq"), R2B_mean, R2B_trace),
               names_to = "measure", values_to = "r2") %>%
  mutate(
    stable = stable == 1,
    measure_lab = case_when(
      str_detect(measure, "R2B_eq") ~ paste("Equation", str_match(measure, "\\[(\\d+)\\]")[, 2]),
      measure == "R2B_mean"         ~ "Mean across equations",
      measure == "R2B_trace"        ~ "Trace"
    ),
    measure_lab = fct_relevel(factor(measure_lab), "Mean across equations", "Trace",
                              after = Inf),
    model_lab = label_model(model)
  )

r2_summary <- r2_draws %>%
  group_by(model, model_lab, p, mode, measure, measure_lab) %>%
  summarise(
    n_draws   = n(),
    prop_stat = mean(stable),
    mcse      = sqrt(prop_stat * (1 - prop_stat) / n_draws),
    r2_med    = median(r2),
    r2_q05    = unname(quantile(r2, 0.05)),
    r2_q95    = unname(quantile(r2, 0.95)),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )
```

## Prior-implied R2 by lag order

```{r}
arr2_ref <- with(s$arr2_flat,
                 qbeta(c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), mean_R2 * prec_R2, (1 - mean_R2) * prec_R2))

p_prior_r2 <- r2_summary %>%
  filter(mode == "prior", measure == "R2B_mean") %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, r2_med, colour = model_lab, fill = model_lab)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = arr2_ref[2], linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = arr2_ref[c(1, 3)], linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = r2_q05, ymax = r2_q95), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p",
       y = expression("Prior-implied mean Bayesian " * R^2),
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Prior-implied mean Bayesian R-squared by lag order",
       subtitle = "Median and 90% band; grey lines: ARR2 R2 prior median and 90% interval") +
  theme_minimal()

p_prior_r2
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
p_prior_r2_measures <- r2_summary %>%
  filter(mode == "prior") %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, r2_med, colour = model_lab, fill = model_lab)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = arr2_ref[2], linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = r2_q05, ymax = r2_q95), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ measure_lab, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p",
       y = expression("Prior-implied Bayesian " * R^2),
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Prior-implied Bayesian R-squared by lag order and R2 variant",
       subtitle = "Median and 90% band; dashed line: ARR2 R2 prior median") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_prior_r2_measures
```

## Stationary prior mass by lag order

```{r}
p_prior_stat <- r2_summary %>%
  filter(mode == "prior", measure == "R2B_mean") %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, prop_stat, colour = model_lab)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = prop_stat - 2 * mcse,
                      ymax = prop_stat + 2 * mcse)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = "Proportion of prior draws stationary",
       colour = NULL, title = "Stationary prior mass by lag order") +
  theme_minimal()

p_prior_stat
```

## Coefficient RMSE against the true VAR(2)

```{r}
coef_err <- map_dfr(keep(res, ~ .x$cell$mode == "fit"), function(r) {
  p     <- r$cell$p
  D     <- diag(r$scale, N)
  D_inv <- diag(1 / r$scale, N)
  A_std <- map(A_true, ~ D_inv %*% .x %*% D)

  post_mean <- colMeans(as_draws_matrix(subset_draws(r$draws, variable = "A")))
  idx <- str_match(names(post_mean), "A\\[(\\d+),(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")
  est <- tibble(lag = as.integer(idx[, 2]), row = as.integer(idx[, 3]),
                col = as.integer(idx[, 4]), est = unname(post_mean))

  expand_grid(lag = seq_len(max(p, p_true)), row = seq_len(N), col = seq_len(N)) %>%
    mutate(truth = pmap_dbl(list(lag, row, col), function(l, i, j)
      if (l <= p_true) A_std[[l]][i, j] else 0)) %>%
    left_join(est, by = c("lag", "row", "col")) %>%
    mutate(est = replace_na(est, 0), model = r$cell$model, p = p)
})

set_levels <- c("All fitted coefficients",
                sprintf("True lags (1-%d)", p_true),
                sprintf("Redundant lags (%d-p)", p_true + 1))

rmse_tbl <- bind_rows(
  coef_err %>% filter(lag <= p)                 %>% mutate(set = set_levels[1]),
  coef_err %>% filter(lag <= p_true)            %>% mutate(set = set_levels[2]),
  coef_err %>% filter(lag > p_true, lag <= p)   %>% mutate(set = set_levels[3])
) %>%
  group_by(model, p, set) %>%
  summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((est - truth)^2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = set_levels), model_lab = label_model(model))

rmse_tbl %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(set, p), names_from = model, values_from = rmse) %>%
  arrange(set, p) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !p, ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
p_rmse <- rmse_tbl %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, rmse, colour = model_lab)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = p_true, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ set, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = "RMSE of posterior-mean coefficients",
       colour = NULL,
       title = "Coefficient RMSE against the true VAR(2) by lag order",
       subtitle = "Standardized scale; dashed line: true lag order") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_rmse
```
